data.source: Coffee and Cashew Nut Dataset, cashew part (Makerere University; Nakatumba-Nabende et al., Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/r46c6bpfpf.1, CC BY 4.0): 3,098 field photos of cashew on trees, 640x480, YOLO boxes

excluded_label_files.rule: file has a class-5 box covering at least 60% of the photo: that file numbers 'tree' as 5, unlike the paper (0 tree ... 5 spoilt); its other ids cannot be mapped with confidence

data.split: by source photo (sha256 of file name), 70/15/15; no photo appears in two splits
data.selection: checkpoint with best validation balanced accuracy; temperature and reject threshold fitted on validation; test used once

with_reject.note: no confidence threshold reached the 95% target on validation, so every fruit goes to manual review
